key_points: Raised outlook is the most thesis-relevant catalyst, signaling improving operational fundamentals and management confidence
Amtrak 8-year operating agreement closes a long-running regulatory dispute, removing an overhang and securing passenger revenue
Mexico growth strategy with Union Pacific signals capital-efficient expansion, supporting free cash flow without major capex increases
Stock has already delivered a 32.6% return over the past year, meaning much of the positive news may already be priced in
Combined effect is modestly bullish but tempered by valuation concerns at current levels
